description: Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.

c.request: By patient sex, what are the average aCL IgG and ANA values in the examination data (only examinations linked to a patient, missing values ignored)? Also give each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, unrounded. Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.
c.sql: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio_to_mean_of_sex_avgs FROM per_sex

a.request: For each patient sex (`Patient.SEX`), use every examination record that matches a patient (drop examinations with no matching patient), with each examination counting once even when a patient has several. Give the sex, the average `aCL IgG`, the average `ANA`, and that sex's average ANA divided by the mean of the per-sex average ANA values. Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round.
a.sql: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

b.request: For each patient sex, compute the average aCL IgG and the average ANA over all Examination records joined to a Patient (each examination counted once, NULL values ignored per column), then report each sex's average ANA divided by the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, unrounded
b.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(E.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg, AVG(E.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination E JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM s) AS ana_ratio FROM s

d.request: By patient sex, what are the average aCL IgG and ANA values across all examination records that are linked to a patient (counting each examination once and ignoring missing values), and what is each sex's average ANA expressed as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, left unrounded?
d.sql: SELECT SEX, avg_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS ana_ratio FROM (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX)
